title: Guarantee Certificate v2
description: Closed v2 guarantee certificate. It composes the unchanged statistical body with the v2 binding delta: the certificate is bound by a complete subject, never by the circular v1 top-level spec_hash/config_hash/config_id fields. This schema is reader-only in Sprint 0; it does not authorize or imply v2 certificate issuance.

selected_id.description: Retained from the shared statistical body (required there, type [string, null]) because Mode 2 selection semantics are mechanically equivalent to v1 and a second statistical body must not be forked to change this one field. Intersected here, in the v2 envelope only, with best_config_v2's config_id definition: this makes selected_id required, non-null and syntactically a valid config_id for v2 specifically, without touching the shared body v1 still uses unmodified. Semantic equality with subject.config_id -- selected_id names the SAME configuration the certificate's subject binds -- cannot be expressed in draft-07 and is instead declared in x-traigent-invariants below.

x-traigent-invariants.description: selected_id (from the shared statistical body) and subject.config_id (from the v2 binding delta) must name the same configuration: the certificate's statistical claim and its binding subject must be about the same selection, even though draft-07 cannot express equality between a field composed in from one allOf branch and a field composed in from another.

per_candidate, keyed by candidate id, records each candidate's disposition (one of CandidateDisposition); the entry keyed by selected_id must read exactly 'selected'. draft-07 cannot express a dynamic-key lookup -- per_candidate's keys are open-ended candidate ids, not a fixed property set -- so a certificate whose selected_id names a candidate recorded as, say, 'feasible' rather than 'selected' is still schema-valid and only caught here.
